summary: Iteration-4 regression verification of Kyrenis Pharmacy OS bug fixes. Both new fixes VERIFIED. (1) CameraScanner stop-without-start: 4 rapid start->stop cycles under headless Playwright (no camera / permission unavailable) triggered ZERO pageerrors, ZERO console errors, no React error overlay, no 'Cannot stop, scanner is not running or paused.' text surfaced. try/catch + Html5QrcodeScannerState.SCANNING/PAUSED guard in CameraScanner.jsx works as expected. (2) Non-blocking email dispatch via asyncio.create_task: recall-batch intake (PCM240721) returns HTTP 200 with inventory_written=false in <1s (measured 0.9s wall-clock via new latency assertion added to test_recall_intake_still_200_and_no_inventory). (3) Full pytest suite 32/32 GREEN (24 kyrenis_api + 8 new_features). (4) Sanity check across app: landing (/), pharmacy dashboard (/pharmacy, all 4 tabs render: STOCK INTAKE / POS BILLING / REPLENISHMENT / TELEMETRY), patient hub (/patient) all render without errors and header pill correctly hidden on /patient.
critical_code_review_comments: CameraScanner.jsx stop() correctly guards on Html5QrcodeScannerState.SCANNING/PAUSED and wraps in try/catch — no uncaught rejection path remains. Optional polish: also swallow s.clear() error separately so a partial init still cleans DOM.

server.py: asyncio.create_task(dispatch_alert_email(...)) at lines 306 & 330 — correct. Consider capturing the task handle to a module-level set to prevent premature GC (Python may drop unreferenced tasks); currently harmless for a proxy fire-and-forget but worth an explicit background_tasks.add(t)/discard callback pattern in production.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (added <3s latency assertion on TestEmailDispatchFireAndForget; added fallback default REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL so suite runs without env export)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration-3 fixes verified end-to-end. Pytest requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env or the fallback added to both test files; run via `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/`. CameraScanner regression closed.
